axes.model_access: **Official "Choosing models" page**: pick the v0 model in the in-chat model picker, or add custom models from the AI Gateway catalog. The updated picker and custom models target Enterprise teams (custom models need team-owner approval). The model in a session follows the most recent response until you switch. In-app AI features have a separate ai-models integration page (Grok/fal/Deep Infra etc.).
axes.runtime: **Web form (v0.app); VM-backed chats run in isolated VMs on Vercel Sandbox** (official sandbox page: hosts project files / runs previews / executes commands; state does not leak between chats; it replaces the older in-browser environment). Coding agents are pre-installed in the sandbox (official page: run CLIs like claude directly in the terminal, alongside v0's built-in assistant in the same project).
axes.local_files: Projects live on the v0 platform. The GitHub integration is an official page: code goes into your repositories, branch isolation, PRs and CI follow the standard flow; existing GitHub repositories can be imported (git-import page). **The official states explicitly that GitHub sync only moves code — it does not grant deployment permission via GitHub** (deployment permission follows Vercel roles).
axes.background: **The deployment line is persistent**: preview deployments build per branch, publish updates the Vercel production deployment (official deployments page); deployment errors can be diagnosed and fixed via "Fix with v0" reading the logs (agentic-features page). **Whether build tasks keep running after the page is closed: not verified to an official statement.**
axes.tools: **Agent capabilities are official pages**: web search, browser use, terminal commands, error fixing, external tool integration — all inside the sandbox. Two MCP lines (bring-your-own MCP servers with a preset list / Remote MCP via Marketplace integrations). Database integrations: Supabase/Blob/Neon/Upstash; Figma import; v0 itself can also act as an MCP server called by other agents.
axes.context: The code viewer (browse/edit code, review changes, add comments as next-round context); Design mode visually selects elements, edits styles and writes back to code; projects organize multiple chats. **Cross-session memory: not verified to an official statement.**
axes.permissions: **Tool-call permissions have three modes (Ask/Auto/Full) + Agent Permissions rules** (MCP page and agentic-features page framing). The enterprise side goes through Vercel Enterprise: seats/v0 roles (Builder etc.) and Vercel team roles are managed separately (enterprise page). Security page official framing: do not trust LLM-generated code — security analysis before execution, sandbox isolation, input validation, adversarial testing.
axes.fit:
Good fit: Next.js/Vercel-stack teams (the deployment chain is natively connected), wanting real terminals and pre-installed agents inside a sandbox, unifying enterprise seats with the Vercel account system.

Not a fit: stacks outside the Next.js/Vercel ecosystem (the deployment line is part of the product semantics), non-Enterprise wanting custom models.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md).

**Suggested measurement** (three, each pointing at something the official readable pages do not give):

- **The actual interception granularity of Ask/Auto/Full on terminal commands** (the official gives mode definitions, not a per-command-class matrix)
- **How much context the pre-installed claude and v0's built-in assistant can see of each other when running in parallel on one project**
- **Migration behavior for existing projects on the old in-browser sandbox** (the official page only says it was replaced; no guidance for existing projects)
unknowns:
- Cross-session memory mechanism (not verified to an official statement)
- Whether build tasks keep running after the page is closed (not verified to an official statement)
- The complete allowance-difference table across free/paid plans (the pricing page exists; not enumerated one by one)
- The complete selectable model list on the chat-generation side (the picker changes with plans and the gateway catalog; not enumerated one by one)
